The '''Rancor Colony''' on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] was a colony mothered by [[Scratch (rancor)|Scratch]]. The colony saw battle during the [[Third battle of Felucia]]. The famed [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] of the famed [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], had commissioned a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to destroy the colony so that his temporary battalion could use their colony as shortcut to the [[Yorn Nuro|Nuro]] organization who was working with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was stealing [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] from farms. When the Jedi Knight reached the [[Scratch's Cave|cave]], they [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the rancor's offspring; Scratch saw and attacked the Jedi, however she was killed and failed in her attempt.
